name: Narendra Modi
period_active: PM since 26 May 2014; began third consecutive term June 2024
foreign_policy_position: Strategic autonomy — multi-alignment across US/Quad, Russia, and Gulf states rather than a single-bloc alliance; assertive posture on China border and Pakistan cross-border terrorism.
current_status: In office, leading NDA coalition government (293/543 Lok Sabha seats) after the BJP fell short of a single-party majority in the 2024 election.
